decisions.reason: Wallet image rendering does not change the rule governing which successfully minted NFTs appear in dashboard inventory.
The source changes NFT image rendering in wallet views, not dashboard visibility of referral commissions.
The wallet image-display requirement does not alter dashboard prize-ticket accounting or visibility.

Although wallet rendering may technically consume NFT metadata, the source does not change any existing metadata identity or attribute rule; the image-display behavior is already owned by the source Requirement.
Rendering an NFT image in wallet views does not change the public countdown label, measure, or scope.
The source does not alter how public mint statistics count completed mints.
The wallet rendering observation does not revise or invalidate any supplied FAQ content.
Wallet NFT image rendering is independent of confirmation-email contents, certificate actions, and the email read-link destination.
The source does not change the deferred Transak provider, payment methods, conversion, or automatic fiat-mint flow.
NFT rendering inside wallet views does not affect the landing-page hero layout or its image-clearance constraints.
The source does not change referral commission amount, trigger, recipient, timing, limit, or payout behavior.
The message describes post-mint wallet presentation and does not change the USDC payment or mint-execution requirement.
